tools.name: price_item
tools.description: Prices one item from a photo or a name. Returns what it is worth as a range, the new and used asking prices, resale, and a confidence.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: New, used, and resale prices for one named item. estimate_low and estimate_high carry a range already priced, or -1 when the title still needs a price.

tools.name: where_to_buy_or_sell
tools.description: Marketplace links to buy one named item new, buy it used, or sell it. Each link is a Worth tracking URL.
